02 / Market signal

The need is less about
another strategy.

It is about turning requests into reliable data, evidence and a repeatable operating process. That practical gap is where these offers sit.

VSME

A common SME language

The European Commission now recommends the voluntary SME standard to simplify sustainability information requested by large companies and financial institutions.

European Commission source ↗
920

French carbon diagnostics

Bpifrance reported 920 Diag Décarbon'Action engagements in 2025, despite a five-month pause in availability—a strong signal of continued SME demand.

Bpifrance source ↗
30%

Suppliers provide no carbon data

EcoVadis and Accenture report that only 21% of suppliers provide detailed activity-level data across Scope 1, 2 and selected Scope 3 categories.

2026 barometer ↗
26%

French SMEs now use AI

Yet only 5% report task automation and 5% data analysis use cases. The opportunity is careful, lightweight implementation—not an AI transformation pitch.

France Num source ↗

These figures are market signals, not legal advice. Every engagement starts by checking the client's actual context and obligations.
